name: EgoSafetyBench
summary: 评测具身视觉语言模型能否根据第一人称视频在运行时识别危险并提供安全防护的诊断基准。
summaryEn: A diagnostic egocentric-video benchmark testing whether embodied VLMs can identify hazards and act as runtime safety guards.
scale: Frozen benchmark with 36 bundled preview examples
scaleZh: 冻结版基准，仓库内含 36 个预览示例
licenseZh: 仓库采用 Apache-2.0；源数据条款见发布页
accessZh: 数据集已在 Hugging Face 提供
verdict: 面向具身智能体运行时风险预测的第一人称视频基准
verdictEn: An egocentric-video benchmark for runtime risk prediction in embodied agents
wmNote: 从早期视觉状态判断后续安全风险，与预测式世界建模直接相关。
wmNoteEn: Inferring future safety risks from early visual state directly relates to predictive world modeling.
